title: Apparel and Footwear Return Window
text: Apparel and footwear items are eligible for return within 7 days of delivery when the item is unused, undamaged, and has its original tags and packaging.

title: Apparel and Footwear Return Window
text: The return request must be raised within the applicable return window shown on the order.

title: Electronics Return Window
text: Eligible electronics products may be returned within 10 days of delivery when the item is defective, damaged, or the wrong product was delivered.

title: Electronics Return Window
text: Some electronics may require brand-authorized inspection or troubleshooting before a return is approved.

title: Home Products Return Window
text: Eligible home products can generally be returned within 7 days of delivery when the product is unused and in acceptable condition.

title: Home Products Return Window
text: Large or installed items may require inspection before reverse pickup or refund approval.

title: COD Refund Timeline
text: For an eligible cash-on-delivery order, the refund is initiated after the returned item passes the required verification step.

title: COD Refund Timeline
text: Once initiated, the refund is normally credited to the bank account or other approved destination within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Prepaid Refund Timeline
text: For an eligible prepaid return, the refund is initiated after the returned product passes verification.

title: Prepaid Refund Timeline
text: The amount is normally credited back to the original payment method within 3 to 5 business days after refund initiation.

title: Standard Delivery SLA
text: Standard delivery is targeted within the estimated delivery date displayed for the order.

title: Standard Delivery SLA
text: Delivery estimates can vary by seller, destination, inventory location, and logistics conditions.

title: Delayed Delivery Handling
text: When an order passes its displayed estimated delivery date, the customer can use the order support flow to request an update.

title: Delayed Delivery Handling
text: A delayed shipment may receive a revised delivery estimate based on the latest carrier and seller information.

title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
text: Reverse pickup is available when the return request is eligible and the product is serviceable for pickup at the delivery address.

title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
text: Pickup can be unavailable in some locations or for items requiring customer drop-off instead.

title: Damaged Product Return
text: A product reported as damaged on delivery should be reported within the return or replacement window shown for the order.

title: Damaged Product Return
text: The support process may request photographs or other evidence before approval.

title: Wrong Product Received
text: If the delivered product does not match the item ordered, the customer should raise a return or replacement request within the applicable product window.

title: Wrong Product Received
text: The returned item may be inspected against the order details before the resolution is completed.

title: Non-Returnable Items
text: Some products may be marked non-returnable because of hygiene, safety, personalization, or other category restrictions.

title: Non-Returnable Items
text: The product page and order page should be treated as the source of the item's specific return eligibility.

title: Refund After Reverse Pickup
text: After a successful reverse pickup, the returned item may undergo verification before the refund or replacement is finalized.

title: Refund After Reverse Pickup
text: The applicable refund timeline begins after the required verification and refund initiation steps.

title: Replacement Eligibility
text: A replacement may be offered instead of a refund when the product and seller support replacement for the reported issue.

title: Replacement Eligibility
text: Replacement availability depends on stock, product category, location, and the applicable order policy.

title: Return Condition Requirements
text: Returned products should normally include the relevant accessories, tags, manuals, and original packaging where applicable.

title: Return Condition Requirements
text: Products that show misuse, missing required components, or material damage may fail verification.
